blurb: Skydive Fargo is a non-profit club and member of the United States Parachute Association. They offer tandem jumps with an instructor, static line student training, and AFF progression for students. The club operates since 1967 and requires all jumpers to become club members, with annual dues included in the price of a student's first jump.
extraNote: Annual dues included in the price of a student's first jump and expire at the end of each calendar year
